CREATE TABLE "public"."matching_rules" (
  "auto_post" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(500),
  "description_pattern" character varying(500),
  "exact_amount" numeric(12,2),
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "last_matched_at" timestamptz,
  "match_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "match_type" text NOT NULL,
  "max_amount" numeric(12,2),
  "min_amount" numeric(12,2),
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "priority" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "reference_pattern" character varying(200),
  "scheme_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "target_account_code_id" uuid,
  "target_fund_id" uuid,
  "transaction_sign" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
